0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Hawks visit the Orlando Magic. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (day-to-day, foot fracture, game-time decision), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery). The Hawks won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Atlanta a 45% chance to win.
